nodes.prompt: You receive an SMS: 'Your Kisan Credit card is blocked. Share your OTP to reactivate.' What do you do?
nodes.voicePrompt: SMS आया: 'किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड बंद हो गया। OTP शेयर करें।' आप क्या करेंगे?

options.label: Ignore the SMS — call your bank directly
Ask a family member for advice first

nodes.prompt: You were scammed! ₹20,000 was withdrawn from your account. Banks never ask for OTPs.
nodes.lesson: NEVER share your OTP, PIN, or password. Banks and government schemes will NEVER ask for these. Report fraud to 1930 (National Cybercrime Helpline).

nodes.prompt: Smart! The bank confirmed it was a fraud attempt. Your account is safe.
nodes.lesson: Always verify by calling your bank's official number (back of debit card). Real banks NEVER ask for OTP via SMS or calls.

nodes.prompt: Your family member recognized it as a scam. Good thinking to ask!
nodes.lesson: When in doubt, consult trusted people before acting. Community knowledge is a powerful shield against fraud.
